newsitem.title: YEMEN: Eight dead in Yemen schools shooting.
newsitem.headline: Eight dead in Yemen schools shooting.

text.p: A school headmistress, a teacher and six children were killed on Sunday when a man fired a machinegun at hundreds of pupils at two schools in the Yemeni capital, a security official said.
An Interior Ministry statement said a total of 11 pupils from both schools and three other people were wounded.
The security official said authorities were still receiving casualty tolls from hospitals.
He said the headmistress was an Egyptian woman in her 40s identified as Asma Noman. Her son was also killed.
Police arrested the gunman, described by witnesses as a disgruntled former bus driver at one of the schools.
The security official said he believed the assailant was insane.
